cohort: Participants were 561 antepartum obstetrics transfers to a single level IV maternal care facility between 2016 and 2020 who delivered during the same encounter.
finding: The obstetric co-morbidity index (OBCMI) was demonstrated to discriminate for severe maternal morbidity (SMM) in antepartum obstetrics transfers, with a cut-off score of >= 4 identified as 81% sensitive in predicting SMM.
mod_finding: An OBCMI score of >= 4 was significantly associated with operative delivery.
